description: Državne geodetske točke is a dataset listed in INSPIRE Metadata System Slovenia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by e-prostor.gov.si. In the collection of state geodetic points, data on state geodetic points are kept, which are connected in hierarchical (orders) order: - national horizontal (trigonometric) geodetic networks, - State GNSS networks; - State Elevation (Nivelman) Networks; and - national gravimetric grids. Coverage: SI. The portal shows the English title as "National geodetic points" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Referenčni koordinatni sistemi, položaj v prostoru. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-metadata-si.
